settings.heading: About Aela Daily
settings.text:
Aela Daily is a Berlin-based brand dedicated to bringing the wabi-sabi philosophy into everyday home decor. We believe in the beauty of imperfection, the value of handmade craftsmanship, and the power of natural materials.

Founded in 2026, we work directly with artisans across Asia to create pieces that tell stories — each knot, each weave, each texture carries the maker's intention and skill.

values.title: Artisan Crafted
values.description: Each piece made by skilled hands using traditional techniques

values.title: Natural Materials
values.description: Sustainable fibers — cotton, jute, linen, reclaimed wood

values.title: Wabi-Sabi Philosophy
values.description: Embracing imperfection as beauty. No two pieces alike.
